lp_title: Notes, tasks, code, SAP and teams in one place.
lp_sub: KnowledgeHub brings everyday work together in a calm, secure space: data isolated per client, an encrypted password vault and controlled sharing.
lp_modsSub: Turn on only what your team uses. Modules grow with the plan.
lp_m1d: Rich editor, folders, tags, tasks with due dates and subtasks, calendar and voice notes.
lp_m2d: Encrypted in your browser with a master password that never leaves the device.
lp_m3d: Versioned HTML artifacts, code library, API Playground and whiteboard.
lp_m4d: Systems, transactions, transport requests, ABAP code and the functional side: processes, tests, migration, cutover.
lp_m5d: Teams, resources, skills, projects, allocations and timesheets with the team dashboard.
lp_m6d: Shared folders with per-person permissions and public links with password and expiry.
lp_plansSub: Price per user per month. Paid plans are licensed — ask us for a proposal.
